---
title: "Most draft-eligible college careers end without an NFL outcome at every position, and from the third eligible season the chance of signing undrafted passes the chance of being drafted"
date: "2026-11-22"
description: "Followed season by season on college rosters, most draft-eligible careers at every position end with eligibility running out undrafted, from the third eligible season a player still playing is likelier to sign undrafted than be drafted that season, and which players are counted (a stat line, a recruiting record) moves the drafted share."
followups:
  - "Fit cause-specific hazard models of the three endings with position, conference tier and recruiting rating, as the competing-risks baseline for the draft forecast (F17)."
  - "Check whether the timing of each ending is stable across draft classes before a forecast relies on it."
  - "Compare cause-specific and subdistribution views of position: does a group change how often an ending happens, or how soon?"
  - "Find the roster records CFBD lists before a player enrolled (Joe Burrow at Ohio State the season before he arrived), which start an estimated clock too early."
  - "Fix the eligibility clock for single-season players: nearly every NFL entrant outside the risk set has one season on a roster and an estimated high-school year that makes it look too early."
  - "Add a school guard to the undrafted-signing match, since newly linked signings match the NFL roster's college less often than older links."
author:
  - "AI directed by Nick Giangreco"
freeze: auto
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Most draft-eligible college careers end without an NFL outcome at every position, and from the third eligible season the chance of signing undrafted passes the chance of being drafted}
  %\VignetteEngine{quarto::html}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# ---- Packages, data connection and figure defaults -------------------------
# Load the project's functions straight from the checkout with pkgload; the
# repo is never installed (decision 0042). The site build sets CFB2NFL_ROOT,
# a local render finds the checkout from the working directory.
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(duckdb)
library(ggiraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

# One interaction style for every girafe figure: a clear hover pop, dimming
# of non-hovered marks, a dark tooltip, and toolbar zoom + PNG download.
set_girafe_defaults(
  opts_hover = opts_hover(
    css = "stroke:#111827;stroke-width:2.5px;filter:brightness(1.12);"
  ),
  opts_hover_inv = opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity:0.45;"),
  opts_tooltip = opts_tooltip(
    css = "background:#111827;color:#fff;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:bold;font-size:15px;"
  ),
  opts_zoom = opts_zoom(min = 1, max = 5),
  opts_toolbar = opts_toolbar(saveaspng = TRUE, position = "topright"),
  opts_sizing = opts_sizing(rescale = TRUE)
)

# thousands-separated and percent formatters for inline numbers
fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  formatC(as.numeric(x), big.mark = ",", format = "f", digits = digits)
}
pct <- function(x, digits = 1) sprintf("%.*f%%", digits, 100 * x)
per100 <- function(x) round(100 * x)
per100_1 <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f", 100 * x)

# One color per ending, shared by every figure; the two NFL routes carry the
# color, the endings without the NFL stay gray.
ending_lab <- ending_labels()
state_lab <- c(ending_lab, playing = "Still playing")
state_fill <- c(
  "Drafted" = "#1B9E77",
  "Signed undrafted" = "#7570B3",
  "Eligibility ended, undrafted" = "#6B7280",
  "Left the data" = "#D1D5DB",
  "Still playing" = "#E5E7EB"
)
claim_color <- "#B45309"
rec_lines <- c(
  `Matched recruiting record` = "solid",
  `No matched recruiting record` = "dashed"
)
context_color <- "#9CA3AF"

# ---- Named players (keyed on athlete id) -----------------------------------
# Key on athlete id, never name (recruiting ids collide, decision 0013).
subjects <- tibble::tribble(
  ~who              , ~cfb_athlete_id ,
  "Jordan Travis"   , "4360799"       ,
  "Kyle Allen"      , "559681"        ,
  "Jonathan Taylor" , "4242335"       ,
  "Montee Ball"     , "482389"        ,
  "Bumper Pool"     , "4360169"       ,
  "Paddy Fisher"    , "4035641"       ,
  "Colin Schooler"  , "4245685"       ,
  "Carlton Martial" , "4262107"       ,
  "Zane Zandier"    , "4240855"       ,
  "Jayden Daniels"  , "4426348"       ,
  "Grant Calcaterra", "4241374"
)

# ---- Load the tables -------------------------------------------------------
outcomes <- dbReadTable(con, "outcomes")
# One position and team per player-season (a handful of ids repeat).
roster_pos <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT playerId, season, any_value(position) AS position,
          any_value(team) AS team
   FROM roster GROUP BY playerId, season"
)
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

pos_levels <- position_group_levels()
endings <- career_endings(outcomes, select(roster_pos, -team)) |>
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, c(pos_levels, "Position not recorded")),
    recruited = if_else(
      hs_year_imputed,
      "No matched recruiting record",
      "Matched recruiting record"
    )
  )
never <- never_eligible_entrants(outcomes, select(roster_pos, -team))
comparable <- function(df) filter(df, group != "Position not recorded")

# ---- 2.2 The risk set ------------------------------------------------------
n_players <- nrow(endings)
n_known <- sum(endings$time > 0)
n_unknown <- n_players - n_known
n_never <- nrow(never)
never_qb <- sum(never$group == "Quarterback", na.rm = TRUE)
never_top <- never |>
  filter(!is.na(group), group != "Position not recorded") |>
  count(group, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice(1)
never_one_season <- outcomes |>
  filter(playerId %in% never$playerId) |>
  count(playerId) |>
  summarise(share = mean(n == 1)) |>
  pull(share)
n_missed <- sum(endings$missed_season)
risk_table <- endings |>
  mutate(ending = if_else(time == 0, "unknown", ending)) |>
  count(group, ending) |>
  # Every ending gets a column, even one no group reaches.
  tidyr::complete(
    group,
    ending = c(
      "drafted", "signed_udfa", "exhausted_undrafted", "left_data",
      "censored", "unknown"
    ),
    fill = list(n = 0L)
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = ending, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  left_join(
    count(mutate(never, group = factor(group, levels(endings$group))), group,
      name = "never_eligible"
    ),
    by = "group"
  ) |>
  mutate(never_eligible = coalesce(never_eligible, 0L))

# ---- 2.3 The named players -------------------------------------------------
last_team <- outcomes |>
  summarise(last = max(season), .by = "playerId") |>
  left_join(
    select(roster_pos, playerId, season, team),
    by = c("playerId", "last" = "season")
  )
cast <- subjects |>
  inner_join(endings, by = c("cfb_athlete_id" = "playerId")) |>
  left_join(last_team, by = c("cfb_athlete_id" = "playerId")) |>
  mutate(
    url = explorer_player_url(cfb_athlete_id, as.character(group)),
    Player = if_else(is.na(url), who, sprintf("[%s](%s)", who, url)),
    Ending = case_when(
      ending == "drafted" ~ sprintf("Drafted, round %d", round),
      .default = unname(ending_lab[ending])
    ),
    order = match(ending, names(ending_lab))
  ) |>
  arrange(order, desc(missed_season), hs_year_imputed)
returner <- cast[cast$who == "Grant Calcaterra", ]
and_list <- function(x) sub(", ([^,]*)$", " and \\1", paste(x, collapse = ", "))
ordinal <- function(n) c("first", "second", "third", "fourth", "fifth")[n]

# ---- 3.1 Cumulative shares by position ------------------------------------
horizon <- 3L
# Fewest players at risk for a group's curve or bar to be shown.
min_curve <- 30
ci <- ending_incidence(endings)
ci_all <- ending_incidence(endings, by = NULL)
at_horizon_all <- ci |>
  filter(time == horizon) |>
  comparable()
thin_groups <- at_horizon_all |>
  filter(n_risk < min_curve) |>
  distinct(group) |>
  pull(group) |>
  as.character()
at_horizon <- at_horizon_all |>
  filter(!group %in% thin_groups) |>
  mutate(label = factor(state_lab[state], names(state_fill)))
nfl_share <- at_horizon |>
  filter(state %in% c("drafted", "signed_udfa")) |>
  summarise(nfl = sum(estimate), .by = "group") |>
  arrange(desc(nfl))
exhausted_share <- at_horizon |>
  filter(state == "exhausted_undrafted") |>
  arrange(estimate)
omitted_note <- if (length(thin_groups)) {
  sprintf(
    " Omitted, with fewer than %d players at risk: %s.",
    min_curve,
    paste(tolower(thin_groups), collapse = ", ")
  )
} else {
  ""
}
e1_holds <- any(nfl_share$nfl > 0.5)

# ---- 3.2 The drafted-only curve -------------------------------------------
naive <- naive_drafted(endings)
gap <- ci |>
  filter(state == "drafted") |>
  select(group, time, aj = estimate, lower, upper, n_risk) |>
  inner_join(rename(naive, naive = estimate), by = c("group", "time")) |>
  comparable()
gap_h <- gap |>
  filter(time == horizon, !group %in% thin_groups) |>
  mutate(ratio = naive / aj)
qb_gap <- filter(gap_h, group == "Quarterback")
widest_gap <- slice_max(gap_h, naive - aj, n = 1)

# ---- 3.3 The per-season chance of each NFL route ---------------------------
# Too few players at risk make a per-season rate noise: 500 for all
# positions together, 100 for one group.
min_risk <- 500
min_risk_group <- 100
hz_all <- ending_hazards(endings, by = NULL) |>
  filter(ending %in% c("drafted", "signed_udfa"), at_risk >= min_risk)
hz_group <- ending_hazards(endings) |>
  filter(ending %in% c("drafted", "signed_udfa"), at_risk >= min_risk_group) |>
  comparable()
hz_at <- function(s, t) hz_all$hazard[hz_all$ending == s & hz_all$time == t]
hz_wide <- hz_all |>
  select(time, ending, hazard) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = ending, values_from = hazard)
cross_season <- min(hz_wide$time[hz_wide$signed_udfa > hz_wide$drafted])
draft_peak <- hz_wide$time[which.max(hz_wide$drafted)]
last_hz <- max(hz_wide$time)
e3_holds <- all(diff(hz_wide$drafted) > 0)
hz_group_wide <- hz_group |>
  select(group, time, ending, hazard) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = ending, values_from = hazard)
n_groups_cross <- hz_group_wide |>
  filter(time == last_hz) |>
  summarise(n = sum(signed_udfa > drafted), of = n())

# ---- 3.4 Which players are counted ----------------------------------------
# The earlier posts counted only players with a stat line.
stat_ids <- unique(outcomes$playerId[outcomes$has_stat_line])
share_with_stat <- mean(endings$playerId %in% stat_ids)
treatments <- list(
  "All roster players (main view)" = ci,
  "Players with a stat line" = ending_incidence(
    filter(endings, playerId %in% stat_ids)
  ),
  "Matched recruiting record only" = ending_incidence(
    filter(endings, !hs_year_imputed)
  )
)
sens <- purrr::imap(treatments, \(x, nm) {
  x |>
    filter(state == "drafted", time == horizon) |>
    transmute(group, treatment = nm, estimate)
}) |>
  purrr::list_rbind() |>
  comparable() |>
  filter(!group %in% thin_groups)
sens_wide <- sens |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = treatment, values_from = estimate) |>
  mutate(
    stat_shift = `Players with a stat line` - `All roster players (main view)`,
    recruited_shift = `Matched recruiting record only` -
      `All roster players (main view)`
  )
ol_cmp <- filter(sens_wide, group == "Offensive line")
ol_all <- ol_cmp$`All roster players (main view)`
ol_stat <- ol_cmp$`Players with a stat line`
ol_stat_share <- mean(
  endings$playerId[endings$group %in% "Offensive line"] %in% stat_ids
)
max_other_shift <- max(sens_wide$stat_shift[sens_wide$group != "Offensive line"])
stat_curves <- bind_rows(
  mutate(comparable(ci), treatment = "All roster players"),
  mutate(
    comparable(treatments[["Players with a stat line"]]),
    treatment = "Players with a stat line"
  )
) |>
  filter(state == "drafted", n_risk >= min_curve, !group %in% thin_groups)
# Joe Burrow's roster record starts the season before he enrolled.
burrow <- outcomes |> filter(playerId == "3915511")
burrow_first <- min(burrow$season)
burrow_team <- roster_pos$team[
  roster_pos$playerId == "3915511" & roster_pos$season == burrow_first
][1]

# ---- 3.5 Recruited and unrecruited players ---------------------------------
ci_rec <- ending_incidence(endings, by = "recruited")
ci_rec_group <- endings |>
  comparable() |>
  mutate(cell = paste(group, recruited, sep = "|")) |>
  ending_incidence(by = "cell") |>
  tidyr::separate_wider_delim(cell, "|", names = c("group", "recruited"))
rec_at <- function(s, who, t = horizon) {
  ci_rec$estimate[ci_rec$state == s & ci_rec$recruited == who & ci_rec$time == t]
}
rec_ratio <- rec_at("drafted", "Matched recruiting record") /
  rec_at("drafted", "No matched recruiting record")
share_recruited <- mean(!endings$hs_year_imputed)
e4_holds <- rec_ratio > 1
rec_exceptions <- sens_wide$group[sens_wide$recruited_shift <= 0]
```
:::

*Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved 2026-11-24. Draft classes
after the last complete draft are right-censored: a player whose next
outcome is not yet known counts as still playing up to his last known
season, never as a career that ended.*

## 1. Introduction

The earlier posts counted how often a single eligible season ends in an NFL
outcome; this one takes the 81,771 draft-eligible players on a
college roster, with or without a stat line, and follows the
72,544 whose first eligible season has a known outcome season by
season until his college career ends, in one of three ways that rule each
other out, and asks how those endings differ by position.

+ *Expecting at least one position group where most eligible players reach
  the NFL by their third eligible season.*
+ *Expecting each extra eligible season to raise a player's chance of being
  drafted that season.*
+ *Expecting recruited players to reach the draft more often than players
  without a recruiting record.*

## 2. Data

### 2.1 Each eligible player's college career ends once, in one of three ways

The table defines the clock, the three endings, and the quantities the
figures report; the curves describe position groups, never any one player's
chances.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tibble::tribble(
  ~Term, ~Meaning,
  "Eligible season", "A season on a college roster after which the next NFL draft could select the player (at least three years after high school). Season 1 is his first such season.",
  "Stat line", "At least one recorded statistic in a season. Linemen rarely have one, and before 2016 no defender has one unless he made an interception or a return.",
  "Drafted", "Selected in the NFL draft after that season, or after a later season off every roster.",
  "Signed undrafted", "Not drafted, and first on an NFL roster the following season.",
  "Eligibility ended, undrafted", "His last season on a college roster, with no NFL outcome.",
  "Still playing", "His career had not ended by the last season in the data, including players whose next draft has not happened yet; the curves count him only through the seasons observed.",
  "Not yet known", "His first eligible season's outcome is not known yet (his draft has not happened), so his clock has not started and he is in no curve.",
  "Missed season", "A season off every college roster in the data (a medical retirement, a transfer to a program the data does not cover) followed by a return; not an ending, since a career ends only in his final eligible season. A missed season does not advance the clock.",
  "Position group", "His roster position in his first eligible season, in the nine groups of the [earlier position post](2026-10-24-draft-eligibility-by-position.html).",
  "Cumulative share", "Of the group's eligible players, the share whose career has ended a given way by a given season. Each season's three shares plus the share still playing add to 100% (estimated with the Aalen-Johansen method, which counts every ending).",
  "At risk", "Players still playing going into a season, the denominator for that season.",
  "95% interval", "The range the true share plausibly occupies given how many players are behind it; wider when fewer players are at risk.",
  "Per-season chance", "Of players still playing going into a season, the share whose career ends a given way that season."
) |>
  kable(caption = "The terms used throughout.")
```

### 2.2 72,544 players have a known first eligible season, and 580 NFL entrants never become eligible by the clock

The table reconciles the players behind the curves: those whose first
eligible outcome is not yet known start no clock, and NFL entrants drafted
or signed before their first eligible season by the clock (early entrants,
or players whose estimated high-school year runs late) fall outside every
risk set, the largest group with a recorded position being the
91 offensive line players. Players with no
recorded position (last row) are left out of the curves.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
risk_cols <- risk_table |>
  transmute(
    `Position group` = as.character(group),
    Drafted = fmt(drafted),
    `Signed undrafted` = fmt(signed_udfa),
    `Eligibility ended` = fmt(exhausted_undrafted),
    `Left the data` = fmt(left_data),
    `Still playing` = fmt(censored),
    `Not yet known` = fmt(unknown),
    `NFL entrants never eligible` = fmt(never_eligible)
  )
# A "left the data" ending is shown only when some player has one.
if (sum(risk_table$left_data) == 0) {
  risk_cols <- select(risk_cols, -`Left the data`)
}
risk_cols |>
  kable(
    caption = sprintf(
      "Players in the risk set by how their careers ended, and the NFL entrants the clock never makes eligible, %s of whom have a single season on a roster. Counts are players, not seasons.",
      pct(never_one_season, 0)
    ),
    align = paste0("l", strrep("r", ncol(risk_cols) - 1))
  )
```

### 2.3 11 players trace the three endings, and Grant Calcaterra shows a missed season that is not an ending

the [Explorer](explorer.html); Grant Calcaterra left every roster for a
season mid-career and came back, one of 2,005 players with a

matched to him, not that he was unrecruited.

## 3. Results

### 3.1 By the third eligible season, no position group sends more than 13 in 100 eligible players to the NFL

*Expecting at least one position group where most eligible players reach
the NFL by their third eligible season.* ❌

```{.r .cell-code}
p31 <- at_horizon |>
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, rev(as.character(nfl_share$group))),
    tooltip = sprintf(
      "%s, season %d: %s %s (95%% CI %s to %s; %s players at risk going into season %d)",
      group, time, pct(estimate), tolower(label), pct(lower), pct(upper),
      fmt(n_risk), time
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(100 * estimate, group, fill = label)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    # group = label keeps the stack in ending order; data_id would otherwise
    # set the stacking groups.
    aes(tooltip = tooltip, data_id = paste(group, state), group = label),
    width = 0.75,
    color = "#9CA3AF",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = nfl_share |>
      mutate(group = factor(group, rev(as.character(nfl_share$group)))),
    aes(x = 101, y = group, label = sprintf("NFL %s", pct(nfl, 0))),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 4.6,
    color = claim_color
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = state_fill) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
    limits = c(0, 112),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("Reaching the NFL is the minority ending in every group by season %d", horizon),
    subtitle = "Cumulative share of eligible players by how their college careers had ended; right: drafted plus signed undrafted",
    x = "Share of the group's eligible players",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    caption = paste0("Cumulative shares counting all three endings.", omitted_note, " Hover a segment for its interval and players at risk.")
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl() +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
girafe(ggobj = p31, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)
```

```{.r .cell-code}
p31b <- ci |>
  comparable() |>
  filter(state != "playing", n_risk >= min_curve) |>
  mutate(
    label = factor(state_lab[state], names(state_fill)),
    tooltip = sprintf(
      "%s, season %d: %s %s (95%% CI %s to %s; %s at risk)",
      group, time, pct(estimate), tolower(label), pct(lower), pct(upper),
      fmt(n_risk)
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(time, 100 * estimate, color = label, fill = label)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 100 * lower, ymax = 100 * upper), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tooltip, data_id = paste(group, state)), size = 2.4) +
  facet_wrap(~group, ncol = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = state_fill[1:3]) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = state_fill[1:3]) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:5) +
  labs(
    title = "Every ending, season by season, in every group",
    subtitle = "Cumulative share of eligible players by eligible season, with 95% intervals",
    x = "Eligible season",
    y = "Cumulative share (%)",
    color = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    caption = sprintf("Seasons with fewer than %d players at risk are omitted; hover a point for its interval.", min_curve)
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p31b, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 10)
```

### 3.2 Counting only the drafted as an ending reads 7 in 100 quarterbacks drafted by season 3, when the three-ending share is 5

A survival curve with the draft as its only event treats a player whose
career ended another way as if he could still be drafted, handing the
careers that already ended to those still playing (statisticians call this
ignoring competing risks; the result is one minus a Kaplan-Meier curve), so it overstates the drafted share; the second
figure shows the gap in every group, widest in the
offensive line group.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
qb <- filter(gap, group == "Quarterback", n_risk >= min_curve)
p32 <- ggplot(qb, aes(time)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 100 * lower, ymax = 100 * upper), fill = state_fill[["Drafted"]], alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = 100 * aj), color = state_fill[["Drafted"]], linewidth = 1.4) +
  geom_line(aes(y = 100 * naive), color = claim_color, linewidth = 1.4, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      y = 100 * aj,
      tooltip = sprintf("Season %d: %s drafted, counting all three endings (95%% CI %s to %s; %s at risk)", time, pct(aj), pct(lower), pct(upper), fmt(n_risk)),
      data_id = paste("aj", time)
    ),
    color = state_fill[["Drafted"]], size = 3
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      y = 100 * naive,
      tooltip = sprintf("Season %d: %s drafted, counting only the draft (%s at risk)", time, pct(naive), fmt(n_risk)),
      data_id = paste("km", time)
    ),
    color = claim_color, size = 3
  ) +
  annotate(
    "segment",
    x = horizon + 0.08, xend = horizon + 0.08,
    y = 100 * qb_gap$aj, yend = 100 * qb_gap$naive,
    arrow = arrow(ends = "both", length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
    color = claim_color
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = horizon + 0.15, y = 100 * (qb_gap$aj + qb_gap$naive) / 2,
    label = sprintf("Overstated by\n%.1f points", 100 * (qb_gap$naive - qb_gap$aj)),
    hjust = 0, size = 4.6, color = claim_color
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = max(qb$time), y = 100 * max(qb$naive) - 4, label = "Draft as the only ending", hjust = 1, size = 4.4, color = claim_color) +
  annotate("text", x = 2.1, y = 100 * qb$aj[qb$time == 2] * 0.6, label = "All three endings", hjust = 0, size = 4.4, color = state_fill[["Drafted"]]) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_len(max(qb$time)), limits = c(1, max(qb$time) + 0.2)) +
  labs(
    title = "The drafted-only curve keeps counting quarterbacks whose careers already ended",
    subtitle = "Share of eligible quarterbacks drafted by each eligible season, two ways",
    x = "Eligible season",
    y = "Drafted (%)",
    caption = "Solid: Aalen-Johansen estimate with 95% interval. Dashed: one minus a Kaplan-Meier curve that censors every other ending."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p32, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

Of every 100 players still playing, 1.3 are
drafted after their first eligible season, a share that rises through
season 3 to 3.9 and then
levels off, while the undrafted share climbs from
1.0 to 9.2
by season 5; the second figure repeats it for each group, and in
every one
of the 7 groups with players left in season 5
the undrafted chance is the larger.


::: {.cell}

### 3.4 Counting only players with a stat line, as the earlier posts did, raises the offensive line's drafted share from 6 to 11 in 100 by season 3

The shares so far count every roster player; the earlier posts counted only
players with a stat line, 68% of the eligible
players here but only 19% of offensive linemen, and
the figures show that requiring one moves every other group's drafted share
by at most 1.6 points.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
shift_order <- sens_wide |> arrange(stat_shift) |> pull(group) |> as.character()
p34 <- sens_wide |>
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, shift_order),
    is_ol = group == "Offensive line"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = group)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = 100 * `All roster players (main view)`,
      xend = 100 * `Players with a stat line`,
      yend = group,
      color = is_ol
    ),
    linewidth = 1.4
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      x = 100 * `All roster players (main view)`,
      tooltip = sprintf("%s: %s drafted by season %d, all roster players", group, pct(`All roster players (main view)`), horizon),
      data_id = paste(group, "all")
    ),
    color = state_fill[["Drafted"]],
    size = 4
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      x = 100 * `Players with a stat line`,
      tooltip = sprintf("%s: %s drafted by season %d, players with a stat line (%+.1f points)", group, pct(`Players with a stat line`), horizon, 100 * stat_shift),
      data_id = paste(group, "stat")
    ),
    color = claim_color,
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = claim_color, `FALSE` = context_color), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(
    title = "Requiring a stat line inflates the offensive line's drafted share most",
    subtitle = sprintf("Share of each group's eligible players drafted by eligible season %d. Green: all roster players. Orange: players with a stat line.", horizon),
    x = "Drafted",
    y = NULL,
    caption = paste0("Hover a point for its share.", omitted_note)
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
```

```{.r .cell-code}
p34b <- stat_curves |>
  mutate(
    tooltip = sprintf(
      "%s, %s, season %d: %s drafted (95%% CI %s to %s; %s at risk)",
      group, tolower(treatment), time, pct(estimate), pct(lower), pct(upper), fmt(n_risk)
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(time, 100 * estimate, linetype = treatment, group = treatment)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 100 * lower, ymax = 100 * upper), fill = state_fill[["Drafted"]], alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(color = state_fill[["Drafted"]], linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tooltip, data_id = paste(group, treatment, time)), color = state_fill[["Drafted"]], size = 2.2) +
  facet_wrap(~group, ncol = 3) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("All roster players" = "solid", "Players with a stat line" = "dashed")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:5) +
  labs(
    title = "The drafted share by season, all roster players or only those with a stat line, in every group",
    subtitle = "Cumulative share drafted by eligible season, with 95% intervals",
    x = "Eligible season",
    y = "Drafted (%)",
    linetype = NULL,
    caption = sprintf("Seasons with fewer than %d players at risk are omitted; hover a point for its interval.", min_curve)
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p34b, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 10)
```

### 3.5 Players with a matched recruiting record are drafted 4 times as often by season 3 as the rest, and run out of eligibility less often

*Expecting recruited players to reach the draft more often than players
without a recruiting record.* ✅

Keeping only the 29% of players with a matched
recruiting record raises the drafted share in
every group
(the table): by season 3,
10.9% of them are drafted against 2.7%
of the rest, and 62.5% against
77.6% have run out of
eligibility undrafted; the second figure repeats the drafted comparison in
every group.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
sens_wide |>
  select(group, `All roster players (main view)`, `Matched recruiting record only`) |>
  arrange(desc(`All roster players (main view)`)) |>
  mutate(across(-group, pct)) |>
  rename(
    `Position group` = group,
    `All roster players` = `All roster players (main view)`
  ) |>
  kable(
    caption = sprintf("Share of each group's eligible players drafted by eligible season %d, all roster players and those with a matched recruiting record.%s", horizon, omitted_note),
    align = "lrr"
  )
```

```{.r .cell-code}
p35 <- ci_rec |>
  filter(state != "playing", n_risk >= min_curve) |>
  mutate(
    label = factor(state_lab[state], names(state_fill)),
    is_draft = state == "drafted",
    tooltip = sprintf(
      "%s, season %d: %s %s (95%% CI %s to %s; %s at risk)",
      recruited, time, pct(estimate), tolower(label), pct(lower), pct(upper), fmt(n_risk)
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(time, 100 * estimate, linetype = recruited)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 100 * lower, ymax = 100 * upper, group = recruited), fill = context_color, alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(aes(color = is_draft), linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(color = is_draft, tooltip = tooltip, data_id = paste(recruited, state, time)), size = 2.6) +
  facet_wrap(~label, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = rec_lines) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = state_fill[["Drafted"]], `FALSE` = "#4B5563"), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:5) +
  labs(
    title = "Players with a matched recruiting record are drafted more and run out of eligibility less",
    subtitle = "Cumulative share of eligible players by ending, all positions, matched recruiting record (solid) or not (dashed)",
    x = "Eligible season",
    y = "Cumulative share (%)",
    linetype = NULL,
    caption = sprintf("Each panel has its own scale. Seasons with fewer than %d players at risk are omitted.", min_curve)
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p35, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)
```

```{.r .cell-code}
p35b <- ci_rec_group |>
  filter(state == "drafted", n_risk >= min_curve) |>
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, pos_levels),
    tooltip = sprintf(
      "%s, %s, season %d: %s drafted (95%% CI %s to %s; %s at risk)",
      group, tolower(recruited), time, pct(estimate), pct(lower), pct(upper), fmt(n_risk)
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(time, 100 * estimate, linetype = recruited, group = recruited)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 100 * lower, ymax = 100 * upper), fill = state_fill[["Drafted"]], alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_line(color = state_fill[["Drafted"]], linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tooltip, data_id = paste(group, recruited, time)), color = state_fill[["Drafted"]], size = 2.2) +
  facet_wrap(~group, ncol = 3) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = rec_lines) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:5) +
  labs(
    title = "The drafted share, with and without a matched recruiting record, in every group",
    subtitle = "Cumulative share drafted by eligible season, matched recruiting record (solid) or not (dashed)",
    x = "Eligible season",
    y = "Drafted (%)",
    linetype = NULL,
    caption = sprintf("Seasons with fewer than %d players at risk are omitted; hover a point for its interval.", min_curve)
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p35b, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 9)
```

## 4. Summary

Followed to their ending, most eligible careers in every group run out
undrafted, counting only the draft as an ending overstates the drafted
share, signing undrafted becomes the likelier NFL route for a player still
playing from his third eligible season, and the drafted
share moves with which players are counted: requiring a stat line
multiplies the offensive line's by
1.9.

## 5. Discussion

::: {.callout-important}
The NFL routes compete with each other and with the end of eligibility.

- Each season a player stays, the undrafted chance grows faster than the
  drafted chance, so a forecast that pools the two routes, or ignores the
  endings that compete with them, mixes processes that grow at different
  rates.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
The drafted-only curve overstates the drafted share.

- Treating every other ending as censoring keeps counting careers that
  already ended, so the overstatement is largest where other endings are
  most common.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
The drafted share moves with which players are counted.

- Counting only players with a stat line keeps the fifth of offensive
  linemen who recorded one, so it describes a far more drafted group than
  the full line.
- Players with a matched recruiting record are drafted far more often,
  partly as stronger prospects and partly because their clock is known; for
  the rest the data says how a career ended more reliably than when.
:::

Several caveats bound these figures. The population is every player on a
college roster, walk-ons and scout-team players included, so each group's
drafted share describes everyone a program carried, not only its regulars. Some
roster records begin before the player enrolled (Joe Burrow's starts in
2014, at Ohio State), which starts an estimated clock early. A
missed season mixes medical retirements, sit-outs and transfers to programs
the data does not cover. Position is fixed at the first eligible season, so a
player who changed position later is counted at his first one. The most
recent classes are right-censored, and their later seasons carry fewer
players at risk.
